transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Heathrow Express runs to Paddington every 15 minutes; the trip between Paddington and terminals 2 and 3 takes 15 minutes. The Elizabeth line links the airport with Bond Street, Farringdon, Liverpool Street, Paddington, Stratford and Tottenham Court Road, under 40 minutes to central London; pay by contactless card or Oyster. The cheapest option is the Piccadilly line of the Underground from all terminals: under an hour to the centre, with trains stopping at King's Cross St. Pancras, Leicester Square and Piccadilly Circus.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: London black cabs wait at the ranks at each terminal; the drivers are licensed and have passed the Knowledge of London exam, and all vehicles are wheelchair accessible. WeKnow electric transfers operate at fixed fares; their desks are in the arrivals areas of all terminals.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Paid lounges after security, daily. Terminal 2: No.1 Lounges and Plaza Premium, both from 05:00 to 21:00, from £44 and from £40 per person. Terminal 5: Plaza Premium from 04:45 to 21:30, from £35 per person. Terminal 2 also has the airline lounges of Lufthansa, Singapore Airlines, Air Canada and United, Terminal 5 has British Airways lounges.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Excess Baggage Company left luggage, under round-the-clock video surveillance; price per item: up to 3 hours £10, 3–24 hours £15, 24–48 hours £27.50, 48–72 hours £40. After 72 hours, £12.50 for each additional day; after 7 days, £10 per day. Can be booked online.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi in all terminals: choose the Heathrow Wi‑Fi network, follow the on-screen instructions and register. The network is Friendly WiFi certified and filters content unsuitable for children.
